district_name: North Country Union High School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(E) inventory: North Country Union High School District, a union high school district (16 V.S.A. section 748) in the North Country Supervisory Union (member towns: Brighton, Charleston, Derby, Holland, Jay, Lowell, Morgan, Newport City, Newport Town, Troy, Westfield -- Coventry is NOT a member). Operates grades 9-12 and the North Country Career Center.
North Country SU NCUHS board page (official).

board.org_name: North Country Union High School Board

sources.note: North Country SU NCUHS board page (official): rosters by school year 2020-21 through 2026-2027. The full boards of 2020-21 through 2022-23 field 15 members on the per-town split Derby 3, Newport City 3, and one each for Brighton, Charleston, Holland, Jay, Lowell, Morgan, Newport Town, Troy, Westfield; the 2026-2027 roster fields 13 (Westfield vacant since 2022-23 -- the Town of Westfield officer list shows the seat "Vacant 2027" -- and one Derby seat unfilled). The district's articles/apportionment schedule were not fetched (named missing document); the split rests on six years of SU rosters plus member-town officer lists (Charleston 2024 report: Esposito, NCUHS Director, exp 2027; Holland 2025 report: Union School Director Jennifer Harlow Jacobs, exp 2028; Lowell: Sinclair elected March 4, 2025 for three years).

board.post_note: MODEL: one post per member town (proportional, town-only electorates, 16 V.S.A. section 748 pattern; each town elects its own director(s) at its annual meeting for 3-year terms; the district budget is voted by Australian ballot across all member towns). Lowell holds exactly ONE seat (see the Lowell flag in the research file: Sinclair continuous 2020-27; the unfilled March 3, 2026 article was a duplicative re-warning). Holland and Jay each elect a single "Union School Director" who sits on both this board and the NCUJHS board.

directors.name: Gayle Cornelius
directors.note: Brighton's director on the SU's 2026-27 roster. (Distinct from the Gayle Cornelius held in batch 1 for the Brighton town district -- a different post; no membership was minted there.) No term end published.

directors.name: Mary Esposito
directors.note: Term per the Charleston 2024 Annual Report ("N.C.U.H.S. Director, 3 Yrs, Mary Esposito, 2027"). Same person as the Charleston town district director (separate membership).

directors.name: Chelsea Bohannon
directors.note: Derby fields 2 of its 3 seats in 2026-27; the third is unfilled (no vacancy document fetched). No term end published.

directors.name: Jennifer Harlow Jacobs
directors.note: Holland's single "Union School Director" (Holland 2025 Annual Report: 3 years, exp 2028); she sits on both union boards. The SU roster uses the short form "Jennifer Harlow." Same person as the Orleans County sheriff record.

directors.name: Liz Bierworth
directors.note: Jay's union director (succeeded Jamie Pillsbury after 2024-25). The SU Full Board page spells "Bierwirth"; both union board pages spell Bierworth. No term end published.

directors.name: Shannon Sinclair
directors.note: Elected March 4, 2025 to a three-year term (Lowell annual meeting minutes).

directors.name: Alexis Carpenter
directors.note: Replaced Evelyn Saurez for 2026-27. No term end published.

directors.name: Christopher Royer
